title: FiniteStructureMultiplicationLift
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and finite type. Write $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ and $j_n:X_n\to X$. Let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical transition immersion, specified by both pullback projection equations. Let $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ be the canonical composition comparison of tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $p_n:Y_n\to X_n$ be finite, with $g_n:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ giving cartesian transition squares and $j_{n+1}\circ p_{n+1}\circ g_n=j_n\circ p_n$. Let $G$ be a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent] on $X$ with support proper over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and suppose isomorphisms $\psi_n:j_n^*G\cong p_{n,*}\mathcal O_{Y_n}$ commute with $c_n$ and the canonical affine base-change maps followed by the structure-sheaf pullback maps [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change]. Put a_n:G to (j_n p_n)_* O_Yn equal to the adjoint of psi_n followed by pushforward composition [lem-weil-pbc-finite-structure-adjoint-transitions]. There is a unique O_X-linear map mu:G tensor G to G such that its sectionwise product is associative and commutative, and a_n(mu(x tensor y))=a_n(x)a_n(y) for every n, open U and sections x,y of G on U. No unit or ring sheaf is asserted.

proof.text: A proper supporting closed subscheme for G also supports its tensor square and cube. Tensor quasi-coherence and the affine finite-type criterion show that these are coherent. Transport the reduced direct-image products through psi and the tensor-pullback comparison. The pinned composition mate preserves pulled-back tensor sections; the base-change product formula and hpsi imply transition compatibility.

Full faithfulness of completion on the square-to-G Hom set yields the unique product mu. Associativity is equality of two composites from the cube, and commutativity is equality of two composites from the square. They hold after reduction because each O_Yn is a commutative ring. Faithfulness proves the identities on X; evaluate them on elementary tensors to get the stated section laws.

The tensor comparison sends the adjunction-unit image of x tensor y to the tensor of the two unit images. Applying the lifted multiplication and the canonical pushforward composition gives multiplicativity of each adjoint. Conversely that formula determines the reduced multiplication on the local generators of pullback; full faithfulness then proves uniqueness.
